title: Remember the Guru with every breath
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 239
summary: The shabad begins with breath-by-breath remembrance of the Guru as life and wealth. It moves through service, the washing of ego, rescue from inner fire, and finally rests in the certainty that the Guru is powerful enough to carry the soul.
whyItMatters: This one meets the person who feels restless, isolated, or afraid that faith will collapse under pressure. Kept close, it turns remembrance from duty into lifeline, and lets gratitude steady what fear keeps shaking.
takeaway: Keep returning to the Guru as breath, wealth, and shelter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kau simarau saas saas ||
lines.translation: I remember the Guru with each and every breath.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mere praan satigur meree raas ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru is my breath of life, the True Guru is my wealth. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa dharasan dhekh dhekh jeevaa ||
lines.translation: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||1||
lines.translation: I wash the Guru's Feet, and drink in this water. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee ren nit majan karau ||
lines.translation: I take my daily bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਹਰਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam kee haumai mal harau ||2||
lines.translation: The egotistical filth of countless incarnations is washed off. ||2||
I wave the fan over the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਤੇ ਹਾਥੁ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa agan te haath dhe raakhaa ||3||
lines.translation: Giving me His Hand, He has saved me from the great fire. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਢੋਵਉ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai gireh ddovau paanee ||
lines.translation: I carry water for the Guru's household;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅਕਲ ਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jis gur te akal gat jaanee ||4||
lines.translation: from the Guru, I have learned the Way of the One Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪੀਸਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis gur kai gireh peesau neet ||
lines.translation: I grind the corn for the Guru's household.
By His Grace, all my enemies have become friends. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਨਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur mo kau dheenaa jeeau ||
lines.translation: The Guru who gave me my soul,
has Himself purchased me, and made me His slave. ||6||
He Himself has blessed me with His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sadhaa sadhaa tis gur kau karee namasakaar ||7||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, I humbly bow to the Guru. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales bhai bhram dhukh laathaa ||
lines.translation: My troubles, conflicts, fears, doubts and pains have been dispelled;
says Nanak, my Guru is All-powerful. ||8||9||

structure: First, it makes remembrance intimate: the Guru is named with every breath.
Then, it shows service and humility washing old ego and teaching the way of the One.
Finally, it lands in rescue, friendship, love, and the confidence that the Guru is powerful enough to hold you.
